movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands are placed on bent knees.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Spinal undulation flowing from head to pelvis.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low center of gravity; no jumps described.
movement_profile.posture: Low center of gravity with knees bent.

signature_moves.description: A fluid, 'boneless' wave-like movement of the spine from head to pelvis.
signature_moves.name: Spinal Undulation

music_profile.sound_description: A percussion-heavy rhythm played on three drums and an iron bell, described as slow and hypnotic.

basic_steps: Bend knees and place hands on knees.
Initiate spinal undulation starting from the head.
Continue the wave-like motion down through the torso to the pelvis.
